sql: SELECT current_database()

SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_connect_integration),NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_connect_eventsubscription),NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_connect_deliverylog),NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plugins_pluginconfig),(SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM core_systemevent)
SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(value::text)<=8192 THEN value ELSE NULL END,(value IS NULL OR octet_length(value::text)<=8192) FROM core_coresettings WHERE key='system_settings' LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id::bigint AS recording,r.channel_id::bigint AS channel,r.start_time,r.end_time,r.task_id,CASE WHEN octet_length(r.custom_properties::text)<=8192 THEN r.custom_properties ELSE NULL END AS properties,(r.custom_properties IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(r.custom_properties::text)<=8192) AS properties_supported,c.uuid AS channel_uuid,CASE WHEN octet_length(c.name)<=255 THEN c.name ELSE NULL END AS channel_name,c.epg_data_id::bigint AS epg_data_id,(c.stream_profile_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_channels_channeloverride o WHERE o.channel_id=c.id)) AS profile_supported,CASE WHEN octet_length(s.value::text)<=8192 THEN s.value ELSE NULL END AS dvr_settings,(s.value IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(s.value::text)<=8192) AS settings_supported FROM dispatcharr_channels_recording r JOIN dispatcharr_channels_channel c ON c.id=r.channel_id LEFT JOIN core_coresettings s ON s.key='dvr_settings' WHERE r.id=$1 LIMIT 1

SELECT l.id::bigint,CASE WHEN octet_length(l.url)<=1024 THEN l.url ELSE NULL END,(l.url IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(l.url)<=1024) FROM vod_movie m LEFT JOIN vod_vodlogo l ON l.id=m.logo_id WHERE UPPER(m.name::text)=UPPER($1) ORDER BY m.name LIMIT 2

SELECT p.id::bigint,p.clocked_id::bigint,c.clocked_time,jsonb_build_object('task',p.task,'args',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.args)<=2048 THEN p.args ELSE NULL END,'kwargs',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.kwargs)<=1024 THEN p.kwargs ELSE NULL END,'headers',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.headers)<=1024 THEN p.headers ELSE NULL END,'bounded',octet_length(p.args)<=2048 AND octet_length(p.kwargs)<=1024 AND (p.headers IS NULL OR octet_length(p.headers)<=1024),'queue',p.queue,'exchange',p.exchange,'routing_key',p.routing_key,'priority',p.priority,'expires',p.expires,'expire_seconds',p.expire_seconds,'one_off',p.one_off,'start_time',p.start_time,'other_schedule',p.interval_id IS NOT NULL OR p.crontab_id IS NOT NULL OR p.solar_id IS NOT NULL) FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask p JOIN django_celery_beat_clockedschedule c ON c.id=p.clocked_id WHERE p.name=$1 LIMIT 2

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictasks WHERE ident=1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epg_epgsource WHERE refresh_task_id=$1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m3u_m3uaccount WHERE refresh_task_id=$1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask WHERE clocked_id=$2 AND id<>$1)
SELECT octet_length(value::text) AS bytes,CASE WHEN octet_length(value::text)<=1048576 THEN value ELSE NULL END AS value FROM core_coresettings WHERE key=$1

SELECT p.id::bigint,p.clocked_id::bigint,c.clocked_time,jsonb_build_object('task',p.task,'args',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.args)<=2048 THEN p.args ELSE NULL END,'kwargs',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.kwargs)<=1024 THEN p.kwargs ELSE NULL END,'headers',CASE WHEN octet_length(p.headers)<=1024 THEN p.headers ELSE NULL END,'bounded',octet_length(p.args)<=2048 AND octet_length(p.kwargs)<=1024 AND (p.headers IS NULL OR octet_length(p.headers)<=1024),'queue',p.queue,'exchange',p.exchange,'routing_key',p.routing_key,'priority',p.priority,'expires',p.expires,'expire_seconds',p.expire_seconds,'one_off',p.one_off,'start_time',p.start_time,'other_schedule',p.interval_id IS NOT NULL OR p.crontab_id IS NOT NULL OR p.solar_id IS NOT NULL) FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask p JOIN django_celery_beat_clockedschedule c ON c.id=p.clocked_id WHERE p.name=$1 LIMIT 2

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictasks WHERE ident=1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epg_epgsource WHERE refresh_task_id=$1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM m3u_m3uaccount WHERE refresh_task_id=$1),EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask WHERE clocked_id=$2 AND id<>$1)
BEGIN
SAVEPOINT native_dvr_predelete
SELECT ident::bigint FROM django_celery_beat_periodictasks WHERE ident=1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE django_celery_beat_periodictasks SET last_update=$1 WHERE ident=1
RELEASE SAVEPOINT native_dvr_predelete
UPDATE epg_epgsource SET refresh_task_id=NULL WHERE refresh_task_id=$1
UPDATE m3u_m3uaccount SET refresh_task_id=NULL WHERE refresh_task_id=$1
DELETE FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask WHERE id=$1 AND name=$2 AND clocked_id=$3
COMMIT
BEGIN
SELECT ident::bigint FROM django_celery_beat_periodictasks WHERE ident=1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE django_celery_beat_periodictasks SET last_update=$1 WHERE ident=1
COMMIT
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask WHERE clocked_id=$1)
BEGIN
DELETE FROM django_celery_beat_clockedschedule WHERE id=$1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM django_celery_beat_periodictask WHERE clocked_id=$1)
SAVEPOINT native_dvr_clocked_postdelete
SELECT ident::bigint FROM django_celery_beat_periodictasks WHERE ident=1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE django_celery_beat_periodictasks SET last_update=$1 WHERE ident=1
RELEASE SAVEPOINT native_dvr_clocked_postdelete
COMMIT
